failure_story: We sized AAOI as an AI-datacenter optical winner at ~$100 while the filing base case already implied roughly -13% per year on normalized owner cash. The causal chain: Microsoft and Digicomm together supplied ~82% of FY2025 revenue (top five customers 95%), so when Microsoft qualified a second-source 800G transceiver at lower price and Digicomm reallocated distributor share, revenue fell faster than the CATV upgrade cycle could offset. FY2025 capital spending of $179M already exceeded operating cash flow; Taiwan lease right-of-use assets reached $72M by Q1 2026, so the assumed normalization to $130M maintenance capex never arrived and reported free cash flow stayed deeply negative. Equity raises that expanded diluted shares from ~60M to ~76M continued at lower prices, diluting per-share economics while the Amazon warrant added contra-revenue. The stock re-rated from an AI narrative premium to a distressed optical supplier trading on mid-cycle CATV collapse and hyperscaler concentration, producing a severe capital loss despite the rebuilt cash balance.
